title: EOS Property Catalog Entry
description: Standalone Knowledge Catalog Entry Aggregate Root defining one authoritative PRP meaning, its supported numeric value forms, exact unit whitelist and optional condition-type whitelist. Version 1 defines no dimension, conversion, canonical-unit, required-condition, MeasurementQuality, classification, alias or equivalence semantics.

id.description: Stable identity of exactly one Property Catalog Entry. It is not the identity of a PropertyRecord, Observation or concrete value.

name.description: Canonical human-readable property name. It is not identity and is not structurally unique.

description.description: Authoritative human-readable definition of the property meaning. It does not replace structured constraints.

allowedValueTypes.description: One or both numeric value branches currently supported by PropertyRecord and Observation. Array order has no priority or fallback meaning.

allowedUnitIds.description: Exact whitelist of Unit Catalog identifiers. It implies no dimension, equivalence, conversion or display preference.

allowedConditionTypeIds.description: Optional exact whitelist of Condition Type Catalog identifiers. Absence means Conditions are not permitted for this property.

replaces.description: Optional reference to one older Property Catalog Entry replaced by this entry.

replacedBy.description: Optional reference to one newer Property Catalog Entry that replaces this entry.
